harness.scene: The area is a 3D scan of a real hillside property: a thatched lodge, terraced gardens, shrubs and trees on a slope, open to the sky. An altitude geofence a few metres above the ground acts like a roof, so the drone cannot climb over tall obstacles.

scale.detail: Not measured. Recorded so far: Scene units treated as metres at scale 1, without independent calibration. (Shown for information; not enforced.)

passage.detail: Narrowest gap on the flight graph: 0.93 m (the drone is 0.50 m wide) at [-6.3, -3.5, 37.2].

alignment.detail: 96% of 7826 sampled surface cells of the scan's own collider (the altitude fence and sealed hollows excluded) have scan points within 0.50 m (needs 90%).

coverage.detail: 100% of 220 waypoints have captured scan ground below them (needs 90%). Captured means at least 48 scan points within 2 m (5% of this scan's median, 962). 0 waypoints sit over ground with no scan surface within 2.5 m (ground we sealed).

scene-text.detail: The area is a 3D scan of a real hillside property: a thatched lodge, terraced gardens, shrubs and trees on a slope, open to the sky. An altitude geofence a few metres above the ground acts like a roof, so the drone cannot climb over tall obstacles.

routes.detail: 108 routes (12 train, 24 dev, 24 heldout, 48 test) match sim/scenarios/reach-hill-lodge.json.

between.detail: Reactive avoider 70.8%, between straight 25% and planner 100%.

missions-search.detail: Sets match sim/scenarios/mission-hill-lodge-search.json. Each target used once. Oracle completed 4 of 4 development missions.

targets-captured.detail: 84 of 84 targets have at least 48 scan points within 2 m (5% of this scan's median, 962).

targets-sky.detail: 84 of 84 targets are in their column's topmost free space.
